about: Leohpaz's Complete RPG Music Bundle as the game plays it (PIX-416): for each of assets/data/audio.json's tracks and story themes ("theme_<name>"), the track it plays as [the bundle's zip, the file's path inside it], the retro versions to match the pixel art, an "intro" played once before it as [zip, path, the handover in seconds, from the bundle's V03 _README.txt] (where its loop starts: loopBegin), the runner-up and why. tools/music_prep.py reads them out of the zips, levels each to "loudness" (the integrated LUFS the v0.307 tracks are heard at: -37.5 measured off their mono renders, 3 LU more on both channels) never past "peak" dBTP (the Music bus plays Sound.LOUDNESS_DB over it at the full slider, and the web has no limiter), encodes it as MP3 (LAME VBR "quality": Godot loops it without a seam, PIX-416's PR) and writes music_<slot>.mp3 and music.json into the private pixelheim-assets repo (retro-rpg/leohpaz/music/); scripts/fetch-private-art.sh installs them, git-ignored, into assets/audio/paid/, where they stand in for the game's own tracks. The bundle may not be redistributed, so no track enters this repo. Picked by name and measured, never heard: the PR's listening list says which to hear first. A slot audio.json doesn't have is skipped, so the private repo may run ahead.

title.runnerUp: V02 01_Title_Theme_II_Retro (47 s, loud from its first bar)

world.runnerUp: V01 03a-Overworld_Chorus (a choir: wordless or not, Tom to hear) or V02 10_Exploration_Retro
world.why: the Reach is the overworld; without the chorus, as no track may hold words

mirefen.runnerUp: V03 07_ForbiddenSwamp_Retro (the bundle ships it only as an OGG, lossy before ours)

interior.why: a bard's tune, quiet indoors: the houses, the shops, the hall, the keep, the observatory, the forge

inn.why: the inn's common room is a feast hall; its file ends on 0.3 s of silence, so its loop rests there

descent.runnerUp: V03 12_FaeDepths_Retro (98 s, a third the size)
descent.why: the Sea Cave's and the Blackiron Shafts' floors

crypt.why: the Greyhold Cellars and the Kings' Vault are crypts

icecave.why: the Ice Cave's glass and ice

coast.why: Saltmere is a small village by the water; the bundle's only sea track is NorthSeaBattle, a fight

frost.why: the Frostgate pass, high and cold: the bundle has no snow track, so the mystical one

greyhold.why: the castle of Greyhold and its market

fernoir.why: Blackiron (Fernoir), the miners' camp under the mountain

mountain.why: the mountain road, climbed last, to Morvax's forge

boss.runnerUp: V03 02 SandDwellersBattle (intro and loop, its handover at 9.6 s)

dragon.runnerUp: V03 06 NorthSeaBattle (intro and loop, its handover at 10.8 s)
dragon.why: the Night of Bells' dragon on the square is the last fight

victory.why: the ending's festival on the square, looping

theme_dawn.why: the dawn after the Night of Ash, the village burned

theme_ending_rest.why: "Stay with them.": the credits' other cut
